script.text: Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination. English Language Paper 3. Listening and Integrated Skills.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Part A. Task 1. Please look at page 1 of your Question Papers. Write your answers in the spaces provided.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: (5-second pause)

script.speaker: Chris
script.text: Hi Sarah, have you booked the venue yet for the school's Open Day?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yes, Chris. We are going to City Hall this year. It's much bigger than the school hall and can accommodate more visitors.

script.speaker: Chris
script.text: Great choice! What about the date? Have we finalized that?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: We've decided on Friday, the 10th of May. It avoids conflicting with other school events.

script.speaker: Chris
script.text: Perfect! What time will the Open Day run?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It will be from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., a full day of activities. Make sure you get enough sleep, haha!

script.speaker: Chris
script.text: Haha, I will! And what will be the main attraction this year? Anything special planned?

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Definitely! We are hosting a big Science Fair with projects from students across all year levels. It's going to be amazing!

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Part A. Task 2. Please look at page 2 of your Question Papers. Complete the table below with information about different student performances during the Open Day.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: (5-second pause)

script.speaker: Principal
script.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm excited to announce the schedule for our Open Day performances. The Chinese Dance team will perform in the School Hall at 10 a.m.

script.speaker: Student 1
script.text: The Drama Club will be putting on a performance of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the auditorium at 11:30 a.m. It's a modern adaptation, so it will be pretty fun!

script.speaker: Student 2
script.text: The school orchestra will present a variety of classical pieces, with a special violin solo performed by our star student, Emily, at 1 p.m. in the music room.

script.speaker: Student 3
script.text: And finally, the school choir will be singing a beautiful rendition of 'The Climb' at 3 p.m. in the courtyard. We've been practicing really hard!

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Part A. Task 3. Please look at page 3 of your Question Papers. Listen to the monologue and complete the flow chart describing how visitors can get from the school gate to the Science Fair.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: (5-second pause)

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Hello, and welcome to our school's Open Day! If you're heading to the Science Fair, here are some simple directions. First, enter through the main gate.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Then, walk straight ahead until you reach the administration building. You can't miss it; it's the tallest building on campus.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Once you're at the administration building, turn left at the canteen corner. You will notice the aroma of fresh food.

script.speaker: Guide
script.text: Finally, the Science Fair will be on your right side. You'll see lots of exciting exhibits and experiments. Enjoy!

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: Part A. Task 4. Please look at page 4 of your Question Papers. Listen to a short lecture about the history of the school and answer the following multiple-choice questions.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: (5-second pause)

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm delighted to share with you a brief history of our esteemed institution. Our school was founded in 1960 with the aim of providing quality education to students in the region.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.text: Initially, the school was known for its academic achievements, producing top students who excelled in various fields. We strived for academic rigour.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.text: Over the years, many notable figures have graduated from our school, including a successful politician who has significantly contributed to our society.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.text: Recently, the school implemented a new curriculum to better prepare students for the challenges of the 21st century. We are always looking to improve our educational practices.

script.speaker: Announcer
script.text: That is the end of Part A.

School Open Day - Information for Student Helpers

Dear Student Helpers,

Thank you for volunteering to help at our school's Open Day. Here are some important details for you:

Date and Time:

Friday, May 10th, 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

Meeting Point:

School Hall at 8:30 a.m. for briefing.

Responsibilities:

  • Guiding visitors around the school
  • Assisting at the Science Fair
  • Helping with performances
  • Providing information and answering questions

Dress Code:

School uniform.

Contact Person:

Ms. Wong (Teacher-in-charge)

Additional Notes:

Please be punctual and enthusiastic. Your help is greatly appreciated!
